Incident Bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: spike in 5xx/timeouts on inference-main at 1846789012. Suspected causes: KV eviction storm + batch head-of-line blocking after recent quant rollout. Auto-paging oncall.
Priya: I'm oncall. Mateo/Alyssa/Samir please triage KV/runtime/tokenizer. Ops stand by for quick mitigations. Jenna/Nikhil, monitor customer reports.
Mateo: looking at write traces and eviction histograms. There's a clear correlation between a model variant rolled last night (quant-alpha) and increased duplicate KV writes.
Alyssa: tokenizer diff in quant-alpha shows a change in how multi-segment prompts are joined: introduces U+2060 WORD JOINER in some branches. That can make keys appear different.
Samir: batching telemetry shows batch sizes collapse when eviction spikes -> queue depth climbs -> p95/p99 latency balloons. Looks like typical head-of-line blocking.
Priya: immediate mitigations I'll execute: 1) pause quant-alpha rollout 2) set KV to read_only on canary hosts 3) add emergency routing fallback for long-prefix requests to stable model. Executing now.
Priya: /infra model pause --model quant-alpha --target canary
deploy-bot: job 70122 accepted, paused quant-alpha rollout at 1846789245.
Ops: /infra flag set --nodes canary --kv_mode read_only -> applied 1846789301.
Priya: /infra route add --predicate "prefix_len>800" --endpoint "/v1/generate" --model quant-stable --priority emergency
deploy-bot: routing rule added at 1846789355.
Mateo: after these mitigations eviction rate dropping ~68%, tail latency improving ~40%. Customers still see intermittent timeouts.
Jenna: CS: three accounts reported >20s timeouts. Drafting interim notice to impacted accounts. Will coordinate with Nikhil on credits if needed.
Nikhil: will prepare account outreach plan. Hold public status until we confirm mitigation.
Priya: root cause hypothesis: token joiner introduced non-printing separator (U+2060) which persists into serialized key -> different hashing and duplicate keys. Under high reuse, duplicates thrash cache and cause evictions. Also runtime key hashing changed slightly in quant build pipeline causing inconsistent redaction behavior.
Alyssa: confirmation: tokenizer unit tests passed, but parity tests against production prompt corpus were missing. PR link that introduced change: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4567. We need parity preflight to prevent this.
Mateo: short-term fix options: 1) runtime normalize keys (strip WORD_JOINER and other zero-width chars) on write+read 2) dual-write mode for canary (write both legacy and normalized keys) to detect divergence 3) add kv_write_throttle as temporary backstop. Recommend implement 1+2.
Priya: agree. Who owns? Mateo for KV normalization + dual-write; Alyssa for tokenizer parity + linter; Samir for batching CB; DevEx for CI; QA for validation; Ops for runbook + revert.
Mateo: I'll open INF-14001 for kv-normalize-hotfix (includes dual-write canary scaffolding and replay harness). Target: open PR today, due 1846860000. Acceptance: dual_write mismatch_ratio < 0.1% over 1h sampled traffic, p95 latency regression <= 1%.
Alyssa: INF-14002 for tokenizer-parity-preflight + tokenizer linter. Will add incident-corpus-v3 (long-prefix + unicode separators + control chars). Due 1846840000.
Samir: INF-14003 for batching circuit-breaker and stress harness. I'll propose thresholds: max_accumulation_ms=6, max_batch_items=512, queue_growth_trigger=3x baseline over 90s. Due 1846880000.
DevEx Bot: INF-14004 created for ci-quant-preflight job. Note: might need extra CI runner memory (ticket INF-14005).
Priya: I'll create an epic INF-EPIC-980 to track all remediation work and link these tickets.
deploy-bot: epic INF-EPIC-980 created at 1846789600 by Priya.
Mateo: quick log snippet showing mismatch: ```
[1846789124] write_kv(key="user:900:prompt:\u2060system|A", legacy_hash=0x1a2b3c, new_hash=0x5f6e7d) -> duplicate entries
[1846789130] kv_eviction/sec baseline=0.003 -> 0.14
[1846789138] batch_queue_depth: 32 -> 4096
```
Alyssa: adding a linter rule to tokenizer repo that fails a PR if token joiner emits any zero-width or control characters unless explicitly allowed and documented. Will include sample corpus in INF-14002.
Mateo: I'll implement runtime normalization that strips zero-width chars before hashing and writing keys. dual-write will be opt-in via runtime flag kv.dual_write=true. During canary we write both keys and compare reads.
Samir: for CB semantics, when queue_growth_ratio > threshold AND eviction_delta > threshold then reduce accumulation window and set a temporary max_batch_items. Also emit event 'batching_cb_engaged' to oncall.
Priya: QA plan: run replay harness against Mateo's PR in dev for 2h, measure kv_mismatch_ratio, eviction_delta, p95 latency; require mismatch_ratio <0.05% and eviction_delta <=1.2x to proceed to canary. QA ticket INF-14006. Due 1846812000.
QA: starting replay now. Will post intermediate metrics.
DevEx Bot: Note - INF-14004 queued, runner memory bump INF-14005 created.
Ops: preparing revert runbook with exact commands to remove temporary flags and routing if canary succeeds. Will add monitor gates: kv_mismatch_ratio, eviction_delta, p95 latency. Ticket INF-14007. Due 1846850000.
Priya: action items summary (owners + tickets + due timestamps as unix ts):
- A1: Mateo INF-14001: kv-normalize-hotfix + dual-write + replay harness. due: 1846860000. PR: draft TBD.
- A2: Alyssa INF-14002: tokenizer-parity-preflight + linter + incident-corpus-v3. due: 1846840000. PR: TBD.
- A3: Samir INF-14003: batching circuit-breaker + stress harness. due: 1846880000.
- A4: DevEx INF-14004: ci-quant-preflight job + runner bump INF-14005. due: 1846855000.
- A5: QA INF-14006: replay & canary qualification. due: 1846812000.
- A6: Ops INF-14007: revert runbook + automated gates. due: 1846850000.
- A7: Support CS-3701: customer outreach & credits plan. due: 1846830000. Jenna/Nikhil owners.
Alyssa: I'll include a short FAQ for customers describing cause (tokenization parity issue) and steps we took.
Mateo: opening PR for INF-14001: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4620 (WIP) - includes normalization function, dual-write flag, unit tests, and a lightweight replay harness.
QA: replay 30m update: kv_mismatch_ratio observed 0.028%, eviction_delta 1.05x, p95 latency +0.6%. Continuing run.
Mateo: thanks QA. If we hold <0.05% and eviction_delta ~1.05x after 2h, we'll schedule 1% canary for 30m with dual_write=true. Ops prepare canary commands and automated abort (mismatch_ratio>0.1% or eviction_delta>2x).
DevEx Bot: runner bump request INF-14005 approved in principle; scheduling allocation.
Jenna: customer comms: sending targeted interim to impacted accounts now. Will follow-up with canary ETA.
Nikhil: coordinate credits with finance for affected accounts; draft will be ready in 24h.
Priya: postmortem scheduling: propose review meeting tomorrow 11:00 PT (1846812000). postmortem owner?
Alyssa: I'll own the postmortem writeup and run the review. postmortem doc link (draft): https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/INF-14001-draft (private).
postmortem-bot: Postmortem doc stub created and assigned to Alyssa at 1846790000.
QA: 2h replay complete: kv_mismatch_ratio=0.032%, eviction_delta=1.07x, p95 +0.7%. PASS for canary qualification. Report attached to INF-14006.
Ops: scheduling 1% canary for 30m now at 1846794200 with dual_write=true. Abort conditions: kv_mismatch_ratio>0.1% or eviction_delta>2x baseline.
deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated at 1846794260: quant-alpha with kv.dual_write=true -> 1% traffic.
deploy-bot: 10m checkpoint: kv_mismatch_ratio=0.028%, eviction_delta stable, no abort.
Mateo: monitoring logs: dual-write mismatch events logged with redacted key samples for debugging. Tooling will redact sensitive parts.
Samir: monitoring batching metrics: queue_growth stable, no CB engagement yet.
Priya: if 1% holds 30m then we'll ramp to 10% for 60m then revert temporary mitigations if metrics Ok. Ops please run revert runbook only after 10% stage passes.
Ops: acknowledged. Revert runbook staged in INF-14007.
Jenna: sending canary start note to impacted customers with expectations.
Nikhil: accounts notified. finance reviewing credit amounts.
Mateo: 30m canary complete at 1846796060. metrics: kv_mismatch_ratio=0.026%, eviction_delta=1.04x, p95 +0.6%. starting 10% ramp.
deploy-bot: 10% stage started at 1846798200. monitoring for 60m.
Priya: great. I'll leave thread open for remediation updates, PR merges, CI integration, and final revert. Alyssa will run postmortem review tomorrow at 1846812000. Please attach final graphs and timelines to the postmortem doc.
Alyssa: will include timeline, graphs (evictions, mismatch_ratio, latency), incident corpus examples, and remediation checklist. Draft link above.
Priya: thanks everyone for quick coordination. Keep incremental updates here. We'll close INF-EPIC-980 when all action items completed and postmortem reviewed. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED (temporary mitigations active) by Priya at 1846796100. Tracking moved to INF-EPIC-980 for remediation and postmortem.
